reassessment_reason: February 2026 official testimony confirms current/historical registration bulk availability and feeds still in development. The public bulk URL still returns an application shell, leaving the actual acquisition and schema contract unverified.

access.bulk: Official February 17, 2026 testimony says a bulk download is available. Anonymous HTTP 200 response at the bulk route contains the application shell, not a documented immutable data file.
access.api: Official testimony describes data feeds as in development; no current public API specification was established.
access.search: SOS public-record and copies pages direct users to the online Business Service Center.
access.fees: Current product price unverified. Published 3 V.S.A. 118(c) includes authority for data sales effective July 1, 2025; that provision is not a price schedule.

fields.summary: No current bulk field dictionary, record identifier lifecycle, status/address codebook, file controls or machine-readable release manifest was established by the reviewed pages.

active_status_semantics: Testimony explicitly includes current and historic registrations; a bulk download cannot be assumed to contain only active businesses.
statewide_completeness: Registry scope is not an establishment census. No current full-extract count, inclusion/exclusion contract or verified retained release was established.
address_zip: No bulk address-role or ZIP completeness guarantee established. Any future projection must separate ZIP5/ZIP4 and avoid treating registered offices as business sites.
automation_terms_fees: No anonymous supported unattended transfer contract, rate limit, current fee or account requirement was verified. Availability testimony does not authorize portal automation.
redistribution: No product-specific retention or derivative/export rights contract was established in reviewed documentation. Legislative revenue authority does not itself answer those questions.
temporal_refresh: No verified current refresh interval, snapshot identity, correction/deletion contract or checksum continuity. Earlier historical weekly descriptions are not current production proof.

citations.evidence: Read-only HTTP 200 application shell; no portal execution or file request.
Page 4: current/historic business registration data, bulk available, feeds in development.
Published statutory text provides optional-services data-sales authority, not actual current bulk pricing.
Official indexed public-record access routes; direct web-tool fetch failed, no request submitted.
Official indexed copies/search guidance; direct web-tool fetch failed.

strongest_next_action: Retain HOLD pending a current schema-only bulk contract: scope, price/account requirements, Record Number lifecycle, status/address definitions, counts, timestamps, refresh semantics, supported transfer and derivative rights. Existing testimony proves product availability only; no account, request, acquisition, portal automation or production action is authorized.
